I changed `request_params_to_args` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` so that, with `convert_underscores=True` (the default), underscore-named headers are no longer copied into the parsed params as leftover keys. The header-param and header-model tests I ran pass (63 tests), but I did not write a test that sends an underscore header and asserts it is rejected, so that behaviour is untested.
